## What changes for the user?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link an issue when relevant.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Include redacted screenshots for visual changes. State any checks that could not run and why.

## Setup, data, or migration impact

Describe configuration changes, schema migrations, external services, or changes to financial calculations and evidence provenance. Write “None” when applicable.

## Before requesting review

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] Tests or other verification cover the behavior being changed.
- [ ] The diff, logs, and screenshots contain no credentials or private portfolio data.
- [ ] Any migration preserves existing installed migration history.
